description.en: 【已归档】上游风控持续加强、UA/请求头格式频繁变动，适配已难以为继。后续开发移步 https://github.com/functy23/dsh-workbuddy-panel
description.zh: 已归档的 WorkBuddy 模型接入插件，把 WorkBuddy 渠道接进 DSH 当模型用，现已停止维护。

description.en: ai-chat 插件的 DSH 宿主：把 QQ 消息交给 DSH 会话回答，带一键接入
description.zh: 把 QQ 会话接进 DeepSeek Harness：一个 QQ 会话对应一个 DSH 会话、重启后映射保留，按说话人分档收放本地工具，三层记忆（事实 / 日记 / 图谱）+ 凌晨巩固，人格四段式，上下文压缩，侧栏九页面板，接入向导会自动装好 Roost 内核与 ai-chat 插件。接好的 QQ 群里任何人都能和机器人聊天；只有主人拿得到完整的本地工具。

description.en: DeepSeekBot: the open-source GrokBot alternative, built on DeepSeek Harness (DSH). PersonaBots with their own identity, persona and Git-backed memory you can share via GitHub; group chat, task delegation, and IM identities on Lark/Feishu, Slack, Discord and WeChat. Works with other DSH plugins. Bot marketplace: market.botharness.ai. MIT.
DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sidebar plugin: stack-safe fork tree, two-track indentation, marquee title, leading/hover slots, and cascade purge.
A writable, git-versioned self for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): persona files injected every turn, gated self-editing, journal→dream reflection, and a Settings › 人格 tab.
Whale Trail · 鲸迹 — automatic local achievement badges for DeepSeek Harness, with whale-themed evolving artwork.

住进 DeepSeek Harness 的 Instagram 助理：带着人格与记忆，把真实的 DSH 使用数据变成 Story / Note 节奏，只有主人自己的私信能指挥它。An Instagram assistant that lives inside DeepSeek Harness: persona-driven Stories & Notes from your real DSH usage, controlled only by your own Instagram DMs.
AI投标灵标书审核 Skill：稳定审核非扫描 PDF/DOCX 的商务标、技术标与通用文档风险
Full-coverage image tiling for DeepSeek Harness vision models, dense-text OCR, and document AI
computer-use in dsh
MCP server bridge for DeepSeek Harness: stdio / streamable-http / legacy-SSE transports, web settings UI (form + JSON), tools as mcp__<server>__<tool>. Burp Suite ready out of the box.
ComfyUI 驱动器（AI-first 合同制）：模型只见合同槽、不见工作流 JSON。文生图/图生图/文生视频/图生视频模板，双重预检防幻觉，官方/自定义节点活体判定。
DSH recap plugin: distills every model request (turn:step) into one sentence, rendered inline in the conversation flow
Message edit / regenerate plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web — Cordis host plugin (/api/msg-edit/*) + dsh.client UI plugin (assistant action strip). Declarative bundle, no install scripts.
Windows Git Bash fix for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): MSYS sandbox conflict + terminal inspector, with the minimal-win collective-thinking preset (we/let's chain)
DeepSeek Harness（DSH）网页客户端插件：实时展示会话级 API token 用量与估算费用，支持缓存命中/未命中分桶、上下文占用，自动适配 DeepSeek 峰谷计价与调价｜DSH web plugin: real-time token usage & cost estimate
DeepSeek Harness 插件：跨会话持久记忆（Hermes 式）

A standalone SearXNG-backed web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web profile. It plugs into the harness's web-search seam (ctx.web), so the agent's web_search tool searches through your own self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of a vendor API.
Live 3D visualization of the DSH plugin ecosystem - every node, edge and state is the real Cordis runtime
Search local Word/PDF/PPT/Excel folders for exam questions and export paper drafts.Extensive use of AI assisted programming
description.zh: 在本地 Word、PDF、PPT、Excel 文件夹中检索试题，并把选中的题目导出为 Word 试卷。

description.en: AI Agent for Quantum Systems
Visual agent-orchestration canvas for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): compose LLM/MCP nodes into a DAG, run it from chat, and export the board as a DSH preset. Ships its own engine — install and run.
Archive the original context before DSH compaction replaces it with a summary — wraps the official summarize(), no engine changes.
把网页版 DeepSeek 接进 DSH 桌面端：内嵌面板 + 与 agent 会话双向搬运（带走/喂回去）
Mobile device capability plugin for DeepSeek Harness: MobileService seam, mock/mobile-mcp providers, agent tools (observe/open_app/tap/type/back), tiered execution policy
A tiny DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin
NovelAI Diffusion V4.5 Full image generation for DeepSeek Harness (nai_generate_image tool)
DSH plugin: strip leftover GPT sandbox_permissions that are not strictly wider than the current session.
适用于DeepSeek Harness Web GUI的GirlsBangCry 皮肤
DeepSeek Harness native plugin: Settings UI for the Roblox Studio MCP bridge - list connected Studio instances, pick the active one, and expose the selection to agents as runtime context.
An automatically mounted, presentation-only progressive tool disclosure layer for every DeepSeek Harness Agent preset in Native, Code, and Both modes.

Preset doctor for DeepSeek Harness: auto-detects broken agent presets (legacy format, renamed packages, stale config keys) and mechanically repairs them to the current 0.1.7+ syntax, with backup, atomic writes and idempotence.
Drive the desktop and Chrome from DeepSeek Harness using the computer-use runtime inside the ChatGPT desktop application.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 LCU 直接操控桌面和 Chrome，不用打开应用就能自动干活。

description.en: Gemini 紫夜主题与角色装饰 for DeepSeek Harness Desktop (Windows and macOS)
dsh plugin: cron scheduling — bounded tasks with calendar & interval rules, delivered to live agents
description.zh: 用 cron 表达式或固定间隔定时给 AI 智能体派活，让任务按计划自动执行。

description.en: 可配置沙箱与审批的运行时策略面：禁用官方 sandbox / fs-sandbox 两行、插入替换行、给出访问规则的值，由替换行接管运行时快照（sandbox:policy / approval:policy）。
A recycle bin for DSH session deletion: deleting a session moves it to a bin where it can be restored, and space is reclaimed on permanent delete or on a retention schedule.
DSH web plugin: searchable model selector for DeepSeek Harness WebUI
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 加个能实时搜索的模型选择器，找模型不用再翻半天。

description.en: OpenCode Zen 免费池供应商：把 opencode-zen 注册进设置 → 模型的供应商列表，可增删改模型、配置图片输入与上下文；无需 API Key，请求强制直连（不走任何代理）。附带「Zen 免费池统计」设置页，按模型累计调用次数与输入/输出/缓存 token。2.1.1 修复 DSH 0.2.1 下统计接口不挂载（官方删除 webRuntime 服务，改用 connection.requestRejection）。

Resilient web search and page extract tools for DeepSeek Harness with free-tier-first Firecrawl / Keenable / SearXNG / DuckDuckGo attempts, then Tavily / Brave / Exa keys, circuit breaker and SSRF-safe extract.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加联网搜索和网页正文提取，多个搜索源自动切换，抓取还防 SSRF。

description.en: 预测准确率考核核对（按准确率、门槛与考核单价核对考核费用的算术自洽，仅提示差异，不作出定性结论）
description.zh: 检查预测准确率考核台账的算术问题，核对周期、科目、预测与实际数据及准确率是否算对。

description.en: DSH数据资产编排主包 — 一键串联脱敏→清洗→盘点→封装，32个插件微内核架构，零依赖TypeScript
Unified subscription providers and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness

Room conversations with native or external coordinators, background delegation, durable goal plans and evidence review, shared member controls, live output and session navigation; the session-granted room model tools (`room_invite` / `room_message` / `roo

Keeps a CURRENT_PROGRESS.md file in each session's working directory: asks at session start whether to create it, reads it instead of asking when it already exists, and appends one entry after every turn.
AdaptiqAI for DeepSeek Harness: models with 5M-token native memory and Knowledge. Sign up, get a model and work without leaving the harness

Git-worktree sessions for dsh: pick 'work on the main checkout', an existing linked worktree, or 'new worktree' right beside the composer's workspace picker. Picking a worktree moves a new conversation's working directory into it on its first message, so
DSH plugin: one-click account balance & quota panel for multiple AI providers (DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Z.ai, Moonshot, MiniMax, StepFun, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter, xAI).
Deterministic, zero-LLM, byte-budget context compaction for DeepSeek Harness, with byte-exact recall of compacted history
description.zh: 不调用模型、按字节预算压缩上下文，压缩掉的历史还能一字不差地还原。

description.en: Native workbench to select project sources, distill and test capability candidates, configure scoped Slack access, and review approvals and persistent tasks.
description.zh: 原生分身工作台：选择项目资料、蒸馏并试跑能力候选、配置有范围的 Slack 访问，查看审批与持久任务。

description.en: Autonomous AI assistant with Foreground, Planner and Worker roles, persistent tasks, restart recovery, on-demand working memory, and optional private-Git collaboration.
description.zh: 自主 AI 助理，提供前台交流、Planner 与 Worker 分工、持久任务、重启接续、按需工作记忆及可选的私有 Git 协作。

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败、等待你处理、已完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛上的同一枚状态灯，并显示三种状态的计数。

description.en: Development-preview A2UI v0.9/v0.9.1 conversation surfaces using official schemas and renderer, session-scoped form actions and non-executing history replay; verified only in bounded synthetic DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 workflows.
description.zh: A2UI v0.9/v0.9.1 对话界面开发预览，使用官方 schema 与渲染器，提供会话内表单动作及不重放动作的历史恢复；仅在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的有界合成流程中验证。

description.en: Runs a fixed set of agent benchmark cases in isolated sandboxes, scores each case with deterministic assertions, and diffs two runs to show which cases regressed after a model, prompt or DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 在隔离沙箱里跑一组固定的 Agent 用例，用确定性断言判分，并对比两次运行，指出换模型、改提示词或升级 DSH 之后哪条用例退化了。

description.en: Read-only Automations tab in the conversation view. It aggregates what other plugins are scheduled to run: last run time, next run time and a rough token-cost estimate, plus today's total spend and remaining balance. It owns no tasks and starts nothing.
description.zh: 会话视图里的只读「自动化」标签页。把其他插件排的自动化汇总成一张表：上次运行、下次运行时间、大致 token 花费，另附今日总花费与余额。它不拥有任何任务，也不会启动任何东西。

description.en: Responsive 22-second whale startup animation with a voiced welcome, playback settings and preview; optional first-screen install and restore for supported Windows DSH NEXT builds.
description.zh: 22秒鲸鱼主题启动动画，支持窗口自适应、原声欢迎语、播放设置和预览；提供受支持Windows DSH NEXT构建的可选首屏安装与恢复。

description.en: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.
description.zh: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

description.en: Hide or show each button under an assistant reply, reorder them by dragging, and collect the hidden ones behind a single ⋯ button.
description.zh: 隐藏或显示助手回答底部的每个按钮，可拖动调整顺序，并把隐藏的收进一个「⋯」。

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and multi-account failover to a backup account.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 模型提供方：内置 15 个订阅与免费模型，提供设置页与按模型容量覆盖、5 小时／每周／每月订阅用量，以及多账号与备用账号自动切换。

description.en: Pins an always-on-top progress bar while the agent runs a turn — the percentage is estimated from tool calls and filled to 100% when the turn ends — and badges the DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing window so large token operations ask for confirmation only during peak hours. The bar runs as a separate Electron process and is skipped when no Electron binary is found.
description.zh: 模型跑一次回合时，屏幕顶部常驻一条进度栏（百分比按工具调用次数递增估算，回合结束才补到 100%），并标出当前是 DeepSeek 峰时还是谷时——大额 token 的操作只在峰时先问你一句。进度栏是独立 Electron 进程，找不到 Electron 二进制时会跳过。

description.en: Auditable token-cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the llm/stream waterfall and records every call with provider, model, input/output/cache-hit/cache-write tokens, usage source and integer nano-CNY cost from an explicit price table. Aggregates by hour, day and session; exports JSON or CSV with a no-write dry-run preview; keeps a manually entered official platform bill in a parallel column with actual-minus-estimate diff. Unknown provider/model routes stay explicitly unpriced. Zero runtime dependencies; no balance query, notifications or animations.
description.zh: 可核对的 token 成本账：包住 llm/stream waterfall，逐次记录 provider、model、输入/输出/缓存命中/缓存写入 token、用量来源，以及按显式价目表算出的整数 nano-CNY 费用；按小时/日/会话聚合，支持 JSON/CSV 导出与不落盘的 dry-run 预览；手填官方平台账单与本地估算并列，给出 actual − estimated 差异。未知 provider/model 保持显式未定价。零运行时依赖；不查余额、不发通知、不做动画。

description.en: CRT terminal skin with a phosphor-green palette, scanlines and monospace type for DeepSeek Harness. Also adds a sidebar dashboard with output speed, CPU/memory and DeepSeek balance; the key stays in the host process.
description.zh: 深色磷光绿 CRT 终端皮肤，带扫描线和等宽字体，用于 DeepSeek Harness。另在侧栏加仪表盘：输出速度、CPU/内存与 DeepSeek 余额；密钥只留在宿主进程。

description.en: QQ chat behaviour layer for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: persona files injected into every turn, a people file keyed by QQ number, sticker picking with probability and pity, optional non-mention replies, sub-personas distilled from group members, and scheduled messages. Enabling the built-in QQ channel accepts private messages from any QQ user and group messages from any group that @s the bot; there is no sender allowlist, so restrict the bot account or keep the channel off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层 QQ 对话行为：人设文件注入每一轮、按 QQ 号认人的群友档案、带概率与大保底的表情包挑选、可选的主动接话、从群友原话蒸馏出的语气子人格，以及定时消息。开启内置 QQ 通道后，任何 QQ 用户私聊机器人、任何群里 @ 机器人都能驱动 Agent；没有发送者白名单，请用群白名单限制或保持通道关闭。

description.en: Disk Janitor for DeepSeek Harness — measures DSH disk usage and clears only regenerable caches, from a settings panel or an agent tool.
description.zh: DSH 磁盘清理插件：统计磁盘占用，一键清理可再生的缓存（Bash 运行时副本、预览缓存、界面缓存等），支持设置面板与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Douyin patent and trademark complaint workflow for DeepSeek Harness: checks user-supplied links, materials and organization identity in a dedicated browser, records each submission state, and queries platform history read-only; never discovers targets or submits without explicit authorization.
description.zh: 抖音专利/商标侵权举报技能包：用专用浏览器核对用户本次提供的链接、证明材料与组织身份，记录提交状态，并只读查询平台历史回执；不自动发现举报对象，未明确授权不提交。

description.en: Rebind which key sends a message and which key starts a new line in the DeepSeek Harness composer; Enter sends and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter breaks the line by default, and either chord can be re-recorded from a settings page.
description.zh: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里哪个键发送消息、哪个键换行；默认 Enter 发送、Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 换行，两个组合键都可以在设置页里重新录制。

description.en: Create verified local cold-backup ZIPs of a Windows DSH Profile and selected home data after DSH exits; restore only to a fresh target with a matching runtime, without certified cross-machine recovery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 退出后，为 Windows DSH Profile 及指定的主目录数据生成可校验的本地冷备份 ZIP；恢复仅限匹配运行时的全新目标，未经跨机器恢复认证。

description.en: Owner workbench for independently connected family WeChat assistants, per-member project and tool permissions, scheduled services and delivery status; API acceptance does not confirm receipt.
description.zh: 通过 Owner 工作台管理家人各自连接的微信助手、按人授予项目和工具权限、安排服务并查看投递状态；接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Bridges DSH to Feishu (Lark) over a long connection: forwards inbound messages into a DSH session and posts the reply back to the same chat, with an optional self-trigger.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到飞书长连接：接收消息并把回复发回同一会话，另带可选的自触发。

description.en: Paper trading in DSH: A-shares and commodity futures, local ledger, built-in FTShare data and K-line, and daily-close practice without buying an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中进行模拟交易，支持 A 股和商品期货，本地账本，内置 FTShare 数据源与 K 线，无需购买 API Key 也可使用日K收盘价练习

description.en: Records the files and folders an AI agent creates, modifies, deletes, renames or moves, shows them in a draggable floating panel with unread counts, and persists the records as per-workspace JSONL logs.
description.zh: 记录 AI 对文件与文件夹的新建、修改、删除、重命名与移动，在可拖拽悬浮窗中实时展示未读数，并按工作区持久化为 JSONL 日志。

description.en: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
description.zh: 使用《One Token Is Enough》论文协议，对 DSH 已配置的模型路由采集并比较单 token 行为指纹。

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
description.zh: 通过 Fotor 生成图片和视频、编辑图片、移除背景、放大图片、上传参考素材及查询积分。

description.en: Composer status bar for GLM Coding Plan quota: 5-hour and weekly limits with reset times, MCP tool usage, and today's model usage, plus a glm_balance query tool.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示智谱 GLM Coding Plan 余量，含 5 小时/每周额度、重置时间、MCP 调用量与今日用量，并附 glm_balance 查询工具。

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in account's five-hour and weekly quota, and limits the Codex route to seven GPT models with low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning (default low).
description.zh: 在设置页驱动 DSH 自带 pi-ai 的 Codex OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，退出时在 OpenAI 撤销会话，显示所登录账号的 5 小时与每周额度，并把 Codex 路由限定为 7 个 GPT 模型，统一 low、medium、high、xhigh 四档推理（默认 low）。

description.en: Registers im_say, a tool that sends each call as its own IM message through dsh-im's proactive delivery service, so a single reply can arrive as several bubbles instead of one block; im_targets and im_target_add list and create the delivery targets it sends to.
description.zh: 注册 im_say 工具，调用一次就通过 dsh-im 的主动投递服务发出一条独立 IM 消息，让一条回复拆成多个气泡而不是一整块；另有 im_targets 与 im_target_add 查看和新建投递目标。

description.en: Jujutsu (jj) version-control panel in the DSH web GUI: a Jujutsu tab renders the jj log change graph with change details, changed files and file diffs, a revset input, and jj-native history edits (drag-to-rebase, split by file, describe, squash, abandon, undo, push); it reads jj directly rather than through git, and every command runs as an argv array through a whitelisted host service with confirmations, timeouts and output caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 Jujutsu（jj）版本控制面板：「Jujutsu」标签页把 jj log 渲染成 change 图，含 change 详情、改动文件与文件差异、revset 输入框，以及 jj 原生历史改写（拖拽 rebase、按文件拆分、修改描述、压缩、放弃、撤销、推送）；直接读 jj 而不经过 git 转译，所有命令以 argv 数组经白名单化的宿主服务执行，带确认、超时与输出上限。

description.en: Prove that a local image edit left every pixel outside its mask untouched. Original, generated and mask PNGs go in; a greppable `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` verdict, a difference heatmap, per-channel statistics, a bounding box and the largest changed pixels come out, plus a self-contained HTML report and `report.json` with a SHA-256 file hash, a canonical protected-pixel digest and a proof digest binding both to the policy. Supports edit and lock mask polarities, a mask threshold, tolerance and alpha-ignoring; PNG color types 0/2/3/4/6, bit depths 1-16, all five filters and Adam7. Zero dependencies, local only — no model call, no network, no upload.
description.zh: 证明一次局部改图没有动蒙版外的像素。输入原图、生成图和蒙版三张 PNG，输出可 grep 的 `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` 结论、差异热力图、逐通道统计、差异包围盒与最大差异像素，并生成自包含 HTML 报告和 `report.json`；后者包含文件 SHA-256、规范化受保护像素摘要，以及把两者与判定策略绑定在一起的证明摘要。支持 edit / lock 两种蒙版语义、蒙版阈值、容差与忽略 alpha；PNG 覆盖颜色类型 0/2/3/4/6、位深 1-16、五种过滤器和 Adam7。零依赖、纯本地：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

description.en: Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 长期记忆插件：文本包、按需检索、可回原始事件、多大脑与工作区边界。

description.en: Per-workspace memory library with manual per-chat opt-in, editable rules, three sharing modes, and continuous forgetting; cards stay readable Markdown.
description.zh: 按工作区隔离的记忆库，支持按对话手动开启、可编辑规则、三种共用模式和连续遗忘；记忆卡仍是可读的 Markdown。

description.en: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

description.en: Quote any message of the current conversation into the composer: pick one from the @ menu, click the quote button on a user or assistant message, or select text and use Quote in the right-click menu. Quotes show as numbered chips in the composer and as summary bubbles above it; after sending, each quote becomes a fenced block so the model can tell quoted text from new text.
description.zh: 把本对话里的任意一条消息引用进输入框：@ 菜单选择，或点用户消息、AI 回复上的引用按钮，也可以选中文字后右键「引用」。引用在输入框里是带序号的芯片，上方浮出摘要气泡；发送后每条引用展开成独立块，模型能分清引用内容与新写内容。

description.en: DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
description.zh: DSH 小秘书：每 15 分钟按当前状态分诊 GitHub 未读通知（已解决的替你关掉），记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日）到时提醒，只读盯着邮箱收件箱；密码只进系统钥匙串。

description.en: Content-catalog guard for WeChat mini-programs: validates catalog.json so every activity price is an integer amountFen, every template renders prices through money(), required fields / duplicate copy / image paths are checked, and the result is an issue list plus a unified diff that can be applied with patch -p1. 29 rules over five groups (catalog shape, required fields and uniqueness, amounts, rendering, images). Three fixes are automatic (legacy yuan amount, string Fen, absolute image path) and preserve the file's own indent, EOL and trailing newline; everything else is reported with a hint instead of being guessed. Dry-run by default; apply re-checks the written file so the report describes what remains. One implementation serves a tool, a conversation panel and a CLI with exit codes 0/1/2. Zero runtime dependencies, no model call, no network.
description.zh: 微信小程序内容目录守卫：校验 catalog.json，保证每条活动金额都是整数 amountFen、页面价格统一走 money()，必填字段 / 重复文案 / 图片路径逐项检查，输出问题清单与可直接 patch -p1 的 unified diff。29 条规则分五组（目录结构、必填与唯一性、金额、渲染、图片）；三条可自动修复（旧「元」金额、字符串分、绝对图片路径），写回保留原文件的缩进/行尾/结尾换行，其余只给修法提示不猜。默认 dry-run，apply 后会重查写回的文件，报告描述剩余问题。一份实现同时服务工具、会话面板与 CLI（退出码 0/1/2）。零运行时依赖，不调用模型、不联网。

description.en: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCLI daemon 当常驻服务直连的 DSH 浏览器工具，替代「每条命令起一次 opencli CLI」的冷启动：oc_status、oc_exec、oc_navigate、oc_snapshot、oc_tabs 五个工具，每个 session 一个常驻自动化标签页。需要本机运行 OpenCLI daemon，并让浏览器里的 OpenCLI 扩展保持连接。

description.en: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill, execute, get_style and browser tools; finds the server binary by probing the usual install paths, and adds a pen-dev skill plus a listener that turns pen.dev plan-limit failures into a short bilingual notice. Unofficial, and ships no pen.dev binaries.
description.zh: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把 pen.dev 额度用尽错误改写成简短中英提示的监听器。非官方项目，不含 pen.dev 任何二进制。

description.en: A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and another to act mode, with per-workspace overrides.
description.zh: 简化RooCode和Cline在VSCode插件上的功能，为 Plan 与 Act 两种模式各绑定一套 provider、模型与思考复杂度，支持按工作区覆盖。

description.en: Local ComfyUI image generation for DeepSeek Harness — discovers or starts the ComfyUI installed on the machine, generates a text-to-image result from a chat request, and attaches it to the conversation.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用本机 ComfyUI 真正生图——自动查找或启动本地服务，在对话里完成文生图并附图。

description.en: Helps keeping tracked updates from plugins added from github with a simple usability UI.
description.zh: 通过简单的可用性 UI 帮助跟踪从 github 添加的插件的更新。

description.en: Adds a scissors button to the DSH composer: freeze the desktop, drag a region, and insert the crop as an image attachment. Ctrl+Alt+1 captures with DSH hidden, Ctrl+Shift+Alt+1 keeps DSH visible. Windows only.
description.zh: 最有效率的 DSH 提示词框截图快捷按钮，不必再粘贴图片：Ctrl+Alt+1 自动隐藏 DSH 窗口截屏；Shift+Ctrl+Alt+1 不隐藏截屏；点按钮自动隐藏窗口截屏，Shift+点击不隐藏。反复截屏时按住 Ctrl+Alt 连续点按钮。按钮放在提示框第三位防误触，截图后可直接改提示词。截图默认存到当前会话文件夹，文件名为秒级时间戳，并默认保存两份（会话文件夹 + DSH 附件库）；删除对话不会连带删图，需要自行在「删除对话」插件里处理。

description.en: Polish button in the composer that rewrites the draft with the model the current conversation already uses: four styles, a fidelity guard that keeps every concrete fact verbatim, one-click revert, and no API key of its own.
description.zh: 输入框润色按钮：用当前会话正在使用的模型改写草稿，四种风格，代码层保真校验确保数字、版本、路径、URL、引号内容与代码标识符逐字保留，支持一键还原，无需自备 API Key。

description.en: Chat quotes for DSH: select text in any message to quote or comment; quotes wait above the composer and become jump-back quote cards in the sent message.
description.zh: 聊天引用：选中消息文字即可引用或评论，引用常驻输入卡上方，发送后变成可跳回的引用块。

description.en: Turns a plugin repository's existing screenshots into a 6-second silent looping hero reel: a VP9 webm that keeps real alpha, a matted gif, and a cover frame, plus a manifest with per-scene holds and sha256s. The timeline is exact by construction (integer holds plus transitions sum to durationMs, and the last scene transitions back into the first so t=0 equals t=duration). Zero runtime dependencies: PNG decode/encode on node:zlib, an SDF card compositor, and ffmpeg as the only external binary, discovered at runtime. Ships a conversation-view panel (pick, reorder, generate, copy the README markdown) and a CLI with a storyboard.json contract.
description.zh: 把插件仓库里已有的截图排成一条 6 秒无声循环首屏短片：VP9 webm（保留真 alpha）、压平垫底的 gif、封面帧，外加记录每幕停留与 sha256 的清单。时间轴按构造即精确（整数停留 + 转场之和等于 durationMs，最后一幕转场回第一幕，t=0 与 t=结束同一帧）。零运行时依赖：PNG 编解码基于 node:zlib，自写 SDF 卡片合成器，唯一外部程序是运行时发现的 ffmpeg。带对话视图面板（选图、排序、生成、复制 README Markdown）与一条接受 storyboard.json 的 CLI。

description.en: A collapsible Recent tasks folder at the top of the sidebar above 工作区: the most recently updated sessions, pinning that ignores recency, running-state spinners, and a per-row menu with rename, fork and archive.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作区」上方多一个可折叠的「最近任务」文件夹：最近更新的会话一目了然，可置顶常用会话（不参与时间排序），运行中的任务带转圈标记，行内菜单支持重命名、在新会话里接着聊与归档。

description.en: Control DeepSeek Harness from a phone via QR code: read chats, send messages, upload images, over LAN, IPv6, or a Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 扫码即可用手机远程控制 DeepSeek Harness：查看会话、发送消息、上传图片，支持局域网、IPv6 与 Cloudflare 隧道。

description.en: Retro CRT phosphor theme: pure-black Matrix green, 40K amber-green or TFEL amber screens with bold glowing text, a code-rain boot animation and a BIOS-style control panel.
description.zh: 复古 CRT 磷光主题：纯黑底黑客帝国绿 / 40K 黄绿 / TFEL 琥珀三种屏种，粗胖发光字，附代码雨开机动画与 BIOS 风控制面板。

description.en: Character persona summaries for DeepSeek Harness: collects moegirl-first public sources, distills them into a reusable persona document through the csp workflow, and keeps a per-character asset library with quality checks, manual source attachment, version snapshots and a settings page.
description.zh: 二次元角色人格总结：萌娘百科优先采集公开资料，按 csp 固定工作流蒸馏成可复用的人格文档，并用资产库管理每个角色的质检、手动资料、历史版本与删改。

description.en: Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.
description.zh: 把密钥和个人信息交给 agent，却不进入它的上下文；带校验位的字段抽取与掩码内容分类。

description.en: Adds backup-then-delete and delete-only actions to the DSH session menu: the session directory, its projection cache and a metadata snapshot are copied to a local archive folder and checked file by file, then the originals are deleted to free disk space; subagent sessions it spawned are handled in the same run, and each backup folder keeps a RESTORE.txt with recovery steps.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话「…」菜单加「备份删除」与「彻底删除」两个入口：先把会话目录、投影缓存和元数据快照复制到本地归档文件夹并逐文件校验，通过后再删除原件以释放磁盘空间；派生的子代理会话一并处理，每个备份文件夹都带 RESTORE.txt 恢复步骤。

description.en: Reorganizes a DeepSeek Harness session transcript into a structured Markdown document with an outline and a table of contents instead of exporting the chat in chronological order. Exposed three ways: a model tool session_to_doc, a composer button, and a loopback-only Web endpoint.
description.zh: 把 DSH 当前会话的对话记录重组成带大纲、章节层级和目录的结构化 Markdown 文档，而不是按时间顺序原样导出。三种入口：模型工具 session_to_doc、输入框按钮、仅回环的 Web 接口。

description.en: Runs the model's bash commands in a local shell chosen in Settings (Niubash, Git Bash, MSYS2, Cygwin, or any bash.exe on PATH) instead of rewriting them for PowerShell, and hides the pwsh tool on Windows.
description.zh: 让 bash 工具在本机设置里选定的 shell（Niubash、Git Bash、MSYS2、Cygwin 或 PATH 上的 bash.exe）中执行命令，不再改写为 PowerShell，并在 Windows 下隐藏 pwsh 工具。

description.en: Forked from j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager (MIT) at its 0.5.6 baseline and substantially reworked since; it registers the same plugin id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original. Adds lossless cordis.patch.yml writes (JS expression values preserved), save-gated per-tool filters, skills governance over the DSH roots plus 10 external agent directories with per-skill/per-source switches enforced through the agent-scope skills provider (disabling actually hides a skill from the model), categories and a restorable trash, GitHub-repository install/update/rollback, zip and SKILL.md import, skills.sh/ClawHub market, workspace view, sidebar panel, dark/light contrast fixes, and update checks against this repository GitHub Releases (npm publication carries OIDC provenance).
description.zh: 本插件在 j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager（MIT）的 0.5.6 基线之上分叉并做了大幅重构；两者注册同一个插件 id，不能同时安装。相对基线新增：cordis.patch.yml 的无损写回（保留 JS 表达式值）、保存闸门式逐工具过滤、覆盖 DSH 原生根与 10 个外部 Agent 目录的技能治理与逐技能/逐来源启停（通过 agent-scope skills provider 真正让模型看不到被停用的技能）、分类与可恢复回收站、GitHub 仓库安装/更新/回滚、zip 与 SKILL.md 导入、skills.sh/ClawHub 市场、工作区视图、侧栏面板、亮/暗主题对比度修复，以及读取本仓库 Releases 的更新检查（npm 发布带 OIDC provenance）。

description.en: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.
description.zh: 在 Telegram 和飞书中指挥 DeepSeek Harness：每轮一条实时进度消息，按钮审批与提问，收发文件和语音，断线和重启不丢消息，飞书扫码接入，按人设置权限。

description.en: A draggable task-tree panel inside the chat page: capture tasks by voice or text, drag to reorder, edge-snapping collapse, and a plain-text queue file you can edit or version yourself.
description.zh: 藏在页面里的任务树面板：语音或打字入库、拖动排序、贴边收起，数据是工作区里的纯文本 queue.md，随时可改可用 git 管。

description.en: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP server for Codex, AstrBot and Claude Desktop.
description.zh: DSH 泡贴吧插件：读帖、写日报、签到，并从高赞回复里按吧建立风格库；回帖与楼中楼默认关闭，受每轮/每日限额。另带只读 MCP server，可接 Codex、AstrBot、Claude Desktop。

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

description.en: Study companion for your materials with guided practice, evidence-grounded feedback, Leitner spaced review, 18 teacher tools, and a Chinese/English student panel using the current DSH session model; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, Python 3.11+, and Python runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

description.en: Sidebar row with today's tokens and estimated spend for DeepSeek Harness; the dialog adds 24h, 7-day, 30-day, 12-month and per-year charts, a contributions heatmap, per-request peak/off-peak pricing from the official DeepSeek price list and the Chinese statutory holiday calendar, and optional WebDAV sync that merges usage across machines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量徽标：显示当天 token 总量与估算费用；弹窗里有 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月与按年图表、活跃度热力图，按 DeepSeek 官方定价与中国法定节假日逐请求计算峰谷价，并可选 WebDAV 云同步合并多台机器的用量。

description.en: Local usage ledger that reads this machine's session logs and reports per-day, per-model and per-workspace token consumption, cache hit rate, tool-vs-chat split and estimated cost, with an in-app editor for per-model prices.
description.zh: 本地用量账本：从本机会话日志统计每日、每模型、每工作区的 token 消耗、缓存命中率、工具请求占比与估算费用，并提供按模型编辑单价的设置面板。

description.en: Dictation that ends up in the repository instead of the chat log: hold the button (or import a WAV), and the plugin archives voice-memos/<id>/ with audio.wav, a rendered waveform.png, memo.md (frontmatter, per-segment timestamps, ready-to-paste quote blocks) and meta.json. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono in the browser before it is sent. Transcription stays local — the harness speechToText service with silence-split windows, or a command worker such as faster-whisper — and when no engine is available the memo is still filed with an explicit status and reason rather than a fabricated transcript. Ships a conversation-view 口述 tab with click-to-seek playback and per-segment quote copy, three agent tools (voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read) and HTTP routes. Zero runtime dependencies, 52 node:test cases, real screenshots in docs/.
description.zh: 把口述变成仓库里的归档，而不是聊天里一闪而过的转写：按住说话（或导入 WAV）后，插件把 audio.wav、渲染好的 waveform.png、memo.md（frontmatter、逐段时码、可直接粘贴的引用块）与 meta.json 落到 voice-memos/<id>/。音频先在浏览器里重采样成 16 kHz 单声道再上传。转写全部本地完成——DSH 的 speechToText 服务（静音切窗补时间戳）或 faster-whisper 这类命令 worker；没有可用引擎时仍然归档，并写明状态与原因，绝不编造文本。带会话视图的「口述」Tab：点波形定位播放、逐段复制引用；另有三个 agent 工具（voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read）与 HTTP 路由。零运行时依赖，52 个 node:test 用例，docs/ 里有真实运行截图。

description.en: Transcribe local audio and video files offline with a composer panel, a CLI, and an agent skill, powered by SenseVoice int8.
description.zh: 在输入框面板、命令行与 agent 技能里离线转写本地音视频文件，引擎为 SenseVoice int8。

description.en: Extract short-video scripts and captions from Douyin, Bilibili, Kuaishou and YouTube, including titles, authors, hashtags and engagement data, through a bundled Python extractor.
description.zh: 提取抖音、B站、快手与 YouTube 短视频的文案与字幕，并带标题、作者、话题与互动数据；抽取器以 Python 随包提供。

description.en: Adds a writing console above the composer with four style tiers (T1-T4) and five rigor tiers (L1-L5), selectable by hand or left to automatic choice; keeps project terminology and banned phrasing in .mem/config.md with a read-only human section; and provides a whale_polish tool that rewrites expression without changing facts.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加写作控制台：四种风格档（T1–T4）与五种严谨档（L1–L5）可手动选择或自动判断；把术语、禁用写法等记入 .mem/config.md（人工区只读）；并提供只改表达、不改事实的 whale_polish 润色工具。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness agents: window and UI Automation automation, local Windows OCR, direct browser reads over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (DOM text, JavaScript, selector clicks), humanised mouse and keyboard input, browser tab management, and a live control panel. It probes the machine on first run, writes its own config, and degrades gracefully when a capability is missing. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体用的 Windows 桌面控制：窗口与 UI Automation 自动化、本地 Windows OCR、通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直读浏览器 DOM 并执行 JS、拟人化鼠标键盘、浏览器标签页管理，以及一个实时控制面板。首次启动自动探测本机能力并写入配置，缺失的能力自动降级而非报错。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段「冰与火」全屏开机片头：冰霜→余烬的启动动画、双语打字机日志与发丝进度线，随后是 Ygritte 的五步身份授权。Esc 跳过，Enter/点击快进，设置页可切换关闭/简易/完整或随时重播；首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸。

description.en: Windows NapCat deployment guide and read-only loopback port checks for DSH, with a user-initiated administrator launcher.
description.zh: Windows NapCat部署指南与本机端口只读检查，附用户手动运行的管理员启动入口。

description.en: Switches between local and remote DSH workspaces and sessions, with optional plugin sync; requires your own relay server.
description.zh: 在本机与远程 DSH 工作区和会话间切换，并支持插件同步；需要自备中继服务器。

description.en: Artifacts-like documents in the sidebar: the agent writes a self-contained HTML document, you comment on any part, send the comments back for the next version, or edit text and formatting yourself. Every change is a new version; local only. A local-only fork of tdoc (https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc), rewritten as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Artifacts 式文档：AI 生成独立的 HTML 文档，你可以对任意位置批注、一键交给 AI 改出新版本，也可以自己直接修改文字和格式。每次修改都是新版本，内容只存在本地。基于 tdoc（https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc）改造的本地化 DSH 插件。

description.en: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 可停靠的侧边面板，用一条 WebSocket 保持 XEChat 聊天在线：支持图片与表情的 Markdown 消息、通过 #showServer 与 #login 切换服务器、在线成员列表、全屏伪装覆盖层，停靠位置、宽度与可视状态持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：把本机 CPU / 内存 / 磁盘 / 网络 / I/O / 温度显示在对话顶栏、输入框底部、侧边栏底部，点开右侧「系统」详情
description.zh: 在对话顶栏、输入框和侧边栏实时显示本机 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、温度和 I/O，点开右侧「系统」看详情。

description.en: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button. The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the original session so the agent carries on from its last sentence. No button, no manual entry: the tool is the only way in. Works on the official desktop app and the official web client; third-party shells are not supported out of the box. Windows only.
description.zh: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适配，第三方壳不在默认支持范围内。仅限 Windows。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 投标符合性响应台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国招标投标法》《中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例》（1999年8月30日通过，2017年12月27日修正、国务院令第613号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 按招标文件逐条核对投标响应台账，只提示漏项和差异，不替你下结论。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 作文评分表核对：依据《普通高中语文课程标准》《普通高等学校招生全国统一考试评卷工作规定》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查作文量表评分表的算术和证据，核对每项标准、等级描述与分数上限是否对得上。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 出口管制物项台账核对：依据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查出口管制物项台账是否闭环：每项是否标注受控、受控项是否带许可证号，帮你提前发现合规漏洞。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 家用汽车三包台账核对：依据《家用汽车产品修理更换退货责任规定》（市场监管总局令第43号）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 检查质保索赔台账的算术和日期是否自洽，帮你在理赔前发现记录错误。
